text:
jamie: quick proposal — let's run a condensed RFC sprint tomorrow 10:00am PT. aim for 3 short reviews (author lightning + tight discussion). who can review, who needs to swap, and can authors confirm pre-reads?
sasha: i can review rfc-optimizer, +1 for lightning format.
kevin: i can be backup reviewer if someone drops, prefer later slot though. 11am works for me if we need to move one.
priya: i'm presenting rfc-async-batcher — i can take the 2nd slot. pre-read uploaded here: https://redwood.docs/r/rfc-async-batcher (summary at top). :memo:
scheduler-bot: heads up — add pre-read link to calendar event. automation rule: if pre-read missing 3h before meeting it gets auto-deferred.
leo: i'm OOO in the morning, can't attend.
jamie: OK — current proposed order: 1) rfc-optimizer (sasha reviewing) 2) rfc-async-batcher (priya author) 3) routing-fallback (needs reviewer). who can take #3?
maria: i can review routing-fallback. prefer to see perf numbers in pre-read. also suggest we tighten timeboxes: 5m author, 10m discuss, 5m actions per RFC.
jamie: agreed on tighter timebox. example agenda block — please paste highlights at top of your doc: 
```
RFC sprint (30m):
- 00:00-05:00 RFC A: author lightning (5m)
- 05:00-12:00 RFC A: discussion + decision (7m)
- 12:00-17:00 RFC B: author lightning (5m)
- 17:00-24:00 RFC B: discussion + decision (7m)
- 24:00-29:00 RFC C: author lightning (5m)
- 29:00-35:00 RFC C: discussion + action items (6m)
(we'll cut or move to defer list if we run over)
```
kevin: i can backfill #3 if maria can't make it.
priya: i've added 3 bullets at top of the doc (motivation, perf impact, rollouts). ping me with questions.
jamie: scheduler-bot — please create the 10:00 event with order [optimizer, async-batcher, routing-fallback], attach pre-reads and add 3h reminder for authors. add a "defer" label for any missing pre-reads.
scheduler-bot: event created: https://calendar.redwood/rfc-sprint-1000 — reminders set (3h, 30m). authors will be pinged automatically.
maria: noted — i'll skim perf section and mark any blockers in comments.
jamie: final ask: authors please keep slide/doc to 1 page + 3 highlights. enforce strict timebox. :hourglass_flowing_sand: if anyone needs to swap, DM me today and i'll reorder.
leo: if someone wants to swap with me for an afternoon slot later this week DM me, thanks.
jamie: thanks all — will post final agenda by 6pm today.
